name: Nadia Rahman
title: Machine Learning Engineer - LLM apps, RAG and NLP
bio: I am a Machine Learning Engineer specialising in large‑language‑model applications, retrieval‑augmented generation and NLP. Over the past seven years I have built churn‑reduction models, intent classifiers and end‑to‑end production pipelines for telecom, fintech and SaaS firms, and I have delivered more than 60 freelance contracts across legal tech, logistics and e‑commerce. I work remotely (UTC+5), write production‑grade Python, and focus on measurable impact – typically improving accuracy by 20‑30% and cutting manual effort by up to 80%.
